text:
elaine: Quick sync — need a decision for Q3 roadmap planning on sequencing private rollout. Two main paths: (A) control-plane-first (VPC control plane + managed routing) then follow with on-prem packaging, or (B) package-first to unblock strict air-gapped customers. sigmaCorp and HealthSys are blockers. Thoughts?
kevin: Control-plane-first reduces long-term operational burden but needs KMS/HSM integration and network setup. ETA ~8w for a minimal control plane.
ajay: From routing/serving POV control-plane-first simplifies model rollouts and fallbacks. Prefer A if we can meet SLA for early customers.
sara: Packaging-first is feasible in parallel if we carve out a lightweight test harness. Packaging effort ~6w but upgrades in-field are riskier for airgapped installs.
tom: Solutions: SigmaCorp explicitly asked for offline installer + signed artifacts. Quote: "can't depend on external control plane for now".
maria: Sales: two enterprise deals at risk if we delay airgap. Revenue ramp tied to earliest delivery. Can we do a staged contract?
elaine: Proposal: hybrid phased plan — do a small control-plane MVP while parallelizing a packaging MVP for 1-2 anchor customers. Minimal launch criteria below. Please react if you disagree. :eyes:
- minimal control-plane: auth + region routing + basic metrics, SLA backstop for canary customers
- packaging MVP: signed offline bundle, install script, upgrade path documented, smoke-tests pass on airgapped lab
- security gating: KMS integration or documented manual key injection for MVP
- ops: rollback plan + support runbook + 24/7 on-call for first 2 weeks
deploy-bot: CI created: private-e2e-tests pipeline started for branch/feature/private-mvp; artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-private-artifacts (retention 7d)
kevin: We need clear resourcing. Estimate: 1 FE, 2 infra, 2 platform engineers for 6-8w to hit MVP. Can product commit headcount?
ajay: Also need model-mirroring test harness for canary traffic. I'll scope in a PR.
elaine: Action items: kevin -> confirm infra owners + ETA by Wed; sara -> packaging test plan draft by Fri; tom -> lock anchor customer test window; maria -> negotiate staged SLA. I'll update the roadmap doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/private-q3 (draft). Backfill any missing acceptance criteria here.
maria: I'll push customer windows to Tom; will flag contract flexibility.
sara: I'll post packaging checklist in the doc and include airgap test matrix.
kevin: Ack, will confirm owners and resource plan.
elaine: Thanks everyone — we'll finalize sequencing in the product-ops sync on Thu. :thumbsup:
